description: This file contains the implementation of the TalkModeManager class, which manages voice interaction, speech recognition, and text-to-speech functionalities for an Android application. It handles speech recognition lifecycle, TTS playback, chat sessions, and configurations related to voice communication features.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: A class that manages voice recognition, speech synthesis, and chat interactions to facilitate voice-based communication within an Android app.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures that the chat session is subscribed if support for chat subscription is enabled.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key used for chat operations.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the TalkMode manager, starting or stopping voice recognition accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Orchestrates the process of sending a wake word command, managing chat, and playing the assistant's response.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays the provided text as speech using TTS infrastructure.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes events from the gateway, notably chat-related events, to handle updates and trigger responses.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables playback feature.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads or updates the configuration for the TalkMode system.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks a given assistant reply text, handling playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for speech input, setting up the recognizer and related resources.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening, cancels recognition, and releases resources.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Starts the speech recognizer listening with specified parameters.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the speech recognition after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Processes recognized speech fragments, potentially triggering recognition of commands.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for silence to finalize recognition.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence duration has been met to finalize speech recognition.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Handles final recognition results, manages chat, and triggers assistant responses.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat updates if needed.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt string to send to the chat API based on transcribed speech and context.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message via session request and returns the resulting run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Waits for the final chat response or timeout.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches the completion status of a chat run.

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Removes and returns the completion status of a specific run.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Removes and returns the text of a completed chat run.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts text content from a chat event message JSON element.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for the latest assistant message after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches the latest assistant message from chat history.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles playing assistant speech from text, including parsing directives and managing TTS playback.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Runs a playback session, managing speech and callback execution.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels ongoing speech playback.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Uses system TTS to speak text, managing utterance lifecycle.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and resets states.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops speech output and resets related states.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if speech can be interrupted.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Stops the silence watch dog process.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and provides access to TextToSpeech engine.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops any ongoing TTS speech.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shuts down TTS engine and clears resources.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if ongoing speech should be interrupted based on transcript.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Checks if playback is enabled and not canceled for current token.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Checks if playback has been canceled or disabled for the current token.

methods.name: ensureConfigLoaded
methods.description: Ensures configuration parameters are loaded.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from session or defaults.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Parses run ID from JSON string.
